digest.component_or_area: test suite hardening — vacuous/non-failing tests across Jira adapter
propositions: test_the_pat_never_appears_in_the_repr_of_the_transport cannot fail because JiraDataCenterTransport constructor never receives a PAT argument and the class has no __repr__, making the literal string check vacuous

test_the_structural_guard_fires_on_a_synthetic_unpaginated_caller re-implements the AST walk inline instead of calling the shared predicate _search_issues_calls_taking_the_default(), so the test cannot detect regressions in the actual guard logic
_search_issues_calls_taking_the_default() hardcodes its input source and takes no parameters, preventing the teeth test from feeding it synthetic unpaginated code without parameterization

test_validate_assignee_exists_returns_the_dc_username only asserts hasattr() which is already tested elsewhere, and never verifies the return value is actually a username string rather than a bool or accountId
test_every_mutating_transport_member_still_fails_on_the_first_429 uses total <= 1 which allows 0 client calls, so members that raise pre-flight still pass without exercising the 429 retry branch
test_an_unknown_backend_raises_the_registry_error_not_key_error never calls select_backend(); it only pins that BackendRegistryError is not a KeyError subclass, narrower than the name promises
